verdict.rationale: Cognee documents `.forget` as its unified deletion command. It covers removing a single data item, deleting an entire dataset along with its graph and vector data, and a full cleanup of everything the current user can delete. That gives single-memory and full-erasure deletion on demand. Missing for 10: deletion of a specific extracted entity or node (per-entity), confirmation that single-item deletion also removes the graph and vector data derived from it, an admin path to erase another user's memories, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
